## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the scope kept unchanged.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` for relevant UI/audio changes
- [ ] Standalone regenerated and release validation checked when relevant
- [ ] Storage/JSON compatibility and no-autoplay behavior preserved
- [ ] New asset redistribution terms and source records included, if applicable

## Limits

Name checks not run, manual acceptance gaps and known risks. Do not include personal listening data, health information, credentials or private machine paths.
